name: OpenAutocatch Self-Hosted Catch-All Mail Receiver
free_limit: Apache-2.0 self-hosted catch-all SMTP receiver with Postfix, Rspamd spam filtering, Maildir message storage, DNSSEC resolution, optional webhook forwarding and Docker deployment; no software subscription or published license quota.
watch_out: Requires your own server with reachable inbound TCP port 25, domain MX/DNS configuration, persistent storage and security maintenance. TLS certificates, IP reputation, storage and infrastructure are not supplied; the separately advertised hosted autocatch.mx offering is not included.
